events.verdict: Mathurin (LAC) and Carter Jr. (ORL) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Carter Jr. (ORL) maintains verticality as he defends Jones Jr.'s (LAC) shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) firms up over his right leg in Dunn's (LAC) path prior to the contact.

After communicating with the Replay Center, it was determined the ruling on the court (defensive goaltending) would stand as called.  Niederhauser (LAC) blocks the shot attempt after the ball makes contact with the backboard and has a chance to score.
Banchero (ORL) legally contests Leonard's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
da Silva (ORL) brings his hands toward Dunn (LAC) as he releases away from the contact.
Bane (ORL) moves his pivot foot prior to the release of his dribble.
Niederhauser (LAC) firms up over his right leg in Banchero's (ORL) path prior to the contact.
Niederhauser (LAC) establishes himself in Banchero's (ORL) path prior to the contact.
Banchero (ORL) moves alongside Leonard's (LAC) path as he defends the drive.
Carter Jr. (ORL) applies his hand to Leonard's (LAC) upper body, and the contact is marginal.
The ball is deflected into the backcourt by Leonard (LAC), and Bane (ORL) legally gains possession of the ball in the backcourt.
Niederhauser (LAC) cleanly blocks Bane's (ORL) shot attempt.
Bane (ORL) directly contests Mathurin's (LAC) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Mathurin's hand after the release.
